tasks.label: dotnet-webapp
process
args: $url='https://localhost:5002/dashboard/'; Start-Job -ScriptBlock { param($u) for ($i=0; $i -lt 300; $i++) { & curl.exe -k -s -o NUL --max-time 1 $u; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Start-Process $u; break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } } -ArgumentList $url | Out-Null; dotnet restore; dotnet clean; dotnet run --launch-profile https

tasks.label: flutter-win-build
tasks.command: flutter pub get; flutter build windows

tasks.label: flutter-win-run
tasks.command: flutter pub get; flutter run -d windows

tasks.label: ExtractorRTD-build
args: $nuget = (Get-Command nuget.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $nuget) { $nuget = 'C:\VisualStudio\nuget.exe' }; if (Test-Path $nuget) { & $nuget restore '${workspaceFolder}\ExtractorRTD\B3WM.ExtractorRTD.sln' -NonInteractive; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } else { Write-Error 'nuget.exe nao encontrado para restore de packages.config'; exit 1 }; $msbuild = & 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe' -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { Write-Error 'MSBuild nao encontrado'; exit 1 }; & $msbuild '${workspaceFolder}\ExtractorRTD\B3WM.ExtractorRTD.sln' /t:Build /p:Configuration=Debug '/p:Platform=Any CPU' /m:1 /v:minimal; exit $LASTEXITCODE
